mapper.select: SELECT INSPECT_CODE, INSPECT_TIME createTime, RESULT_PATH FROM INSPECT_DETAIL WHERE INSPECT_STATE != 1 GROUP BY INSPECT_CODE, INSPECT_TIME, RESULT_PATH ORDER BY INSPECT_TIME DESC
SELECT INSPECT_CODE, ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME FROM INSPECT_DETAIL WHERE INSPECT_STATE != 0 AND INSPECT_CODE = #{inspectCode} GROUP BY INSPECT_CODE, ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME ORDER BY ASSET_ID

SELECT INSPECT_CODE, ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME, MAX(INSPECT_STATE) AS inspectState, REMARK FROM INSPECT_DETAIL WHERE TARGET_STATUS = 1 AND ASSET_STATUS = 1 AND INSPECT_CODE = #{inspectCode} GROUP BY INSPECT_CODE, ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME, REMARK ORDER BY ASSET_ID
SELECT asset_id FROM inspect_detail WHERE inspect_code = #{inspectCode} GROUP BY asset_id
SELECT asset_desk AS id, desk_name AS name FROM INSPECT_DETAIL WHERE INSPECT_CODE = #{inspectCode} GROUP BY asset_desk, desk_name ORDER BY asset_desk

SELECT ID, INSPECT_CODE, ASSET_ID, TARGET_ITEM, TARGET_NAME, INSPECT_STATE, THRESHOLD_VALUE, INSPECT_VALUE, RESULT_MSG, REMARK, EVENT_TYPE_NAME AS eventTypeName FROM INSPECT_DETAIL WHERE INSPECT_CODE = #{inspectCode} AND ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND INSPECT_STATE = #{status} ORDER BY ASSET_ID, TARGET_ITEM, RESULT_MSG

SELECT d.inspect_code AS id, i.asset_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.DESCRIPTION), ''), d.result_msg) AS description, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.title), ''), aet.name) AS alarmTitle, i.alarm_level, i.alarm_code, i.status AS alarmStatus, d.asset_ip1 AS assetIp1, d.asset_name, d.asset_desk FROM inspect_detail d LEFT JOIN alarm_info i ON i.id = d.alarm_id LEFT JOIN ALARM_EVENT_TYPE aet ON aet.id = d.EVENT_TYPE_ID WHERE d.inspect_code = #{inspectCode} AND d.ALARM_ID IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.asset_ip1

SELECT ind.EVENT_TYPE_ID AS eventTypeId, aet.NAME AS eventTypeName, COUNT(DISTINCT ind.ASSET_ID) AS assetCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ind.ALARM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS alarmCount FROM INSPECT_DETAIL ind LEFT JOIN ALARM_EVENT_TYPE aet ON ind.EVENT_TYPE_ID = aet.ID WHERE ind.INSPECT_CODE = #{inspectCode} AND ind.EVENT_TYPE_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ind.EVENT_TYPE_ID, aet.NAME ORDER BY assetCount DESC
